_doc: Where a read stops, by RECORD rather than by field. K42's read-set says a figure is read if any renderer source reads it; every reader here takes a cohort, so a read figure still reaches nothing on the records its reader never receives. `records` are the species records no reader receives at all, `figures` are the declared reads that reach only part of their carriers, and `heads` are the recorded July inflorescences that draw no flower. Routing only: a reached record is one its reader receives, not one a visitor is standing in front of. Held exact in both directions by tools/measure_flora_reach.py. Read ROADMAP K44 before adding a line.
